# Namernut

> Never fall for a name that's already taken. Namernut is a free AI
> business name generator that instantly checks domain, Instagram &
> search availability. It suggests brandable, pronounceable names for
> startups and products, checks live availability of each one as a domain
> (via RDAP/WHOIS across many TLDs) and as an Instagram handle, then scores
> how "brandable" each available name is using an AI web-search-backed
> collision check — how likely the name is to already be crowded by an
> existing company, product, or well-known use. It also checks the name's
> availability live as an Instagram, GitHub, and TikTok handle.

## What it does

- Generates candidate names from an English dictionary word-pairing engine,
  optionally augmented by AI-suggested synonyms, AI-invented names, and
  deterministic alternate spellings.
- Checks each candidate's availability live across selectable TLDs
  (.com, .io, .ai, .co, and others) and, optionally, as an Instagram,
  GitHub, and/or TikTok handle.
- Filters candidates by pronounceability, length, typo-likelihood, and a
  "niceness" (no unintended meaning) check.
- Scores each available name's "brandability" from 0-100: how much existing
  real-world competition (brands, products, well-known uses) the name
  already faces, with a plain-language summary of what was found.
- Lets a user favorite names and keeps a running archive of everything
  found across searches, ranked by brandability.

## Who it's for

Founders, indie hackers, and anyone naming a new startup, app, or product
who wants a name that is (a) actually available as a domain today and
(b) not already crowded out by an existing brand.

## Key facts

- Free to use, no account required.
- Runs entirely in the browser against a Next.js backend; no data is sold.
- Not affiliated with any domain registrar; "Register" links go to
  third-party registrars to complete a purchase.
